title: Derived HTTP clients keep independent default header and cookie lists
summary: All three HTTP clients isolated an edited default header and cookie list from a second derivative of the base client.

subject.symbol: RestClient, WebClient and WebTestClient request exchange

change.description: The client builders copy individual value lists when deriving builders. WebTestClient also takes a snapshot when it builds a client.

notes: The synchronous request factory reads the serialized Cookie header. The two reactive clients deliver requests to an in-process HttpHandler. The initial header is added through defaultHeaders so the fixture supplies a mutable list for the append.

Seeding the retained WebTestClient builder with defaultHeader instead made its later append throw on both pins and on 7.0.10. The retained-builder follow-up also compares the mutable initializer and a fresh derivative.
